# Divergence-Convergence Audit Template

## Current mode

[Generating / Developing / Evaluating / Selecting / Testing / Implementing]

## Divergence review

- How many frames were considered?
- How many stakeholder perspectives were included?
- Were assumptions challenged?
- Were ideas elaborated before evaluation?

## Convergence review

- Were criteria explicit?
- Were constraints classified?
- Was evidence used?
- Were ethical and stakeholder implications considered?
